selectionEntries.name: Regiment

modifiers.value: Regiment is automatically managed by the listbuilder and should appear only once. Remove any extra Regiment entries, then select Regiments of Cadia, Death Korps of Krieg, or Mordian Iron Guard on the remaining entry.

selectionEntries.comment: REGIMENT PRESENTATION ABSTRACTION: the source PDF derives regiment identity indirectly from the mutually exclusive Troop choice. The listbuilder surfaces that decision first as an explicit Regiment selector because it is clearer for note-taking. Regiments of Cadia is the default. Regiment selection controls availability only; PDF prerequisites such as the matching Platoon Commander requiring its Regiment Troop remain separately enforced.

selectionEntries.name: Additional Copy Costs

modifiers.value: Additional Copy Costs is automatically managed by the listbuilder and should appear only once. Remove any extra Additional Copy Costs entries.

selectionEntries.comment: ADDITIONAL COPY COSTS REV21 / GS17. Permanent required accounting entry. The single parent now exposes Troops and Other accounting children. Cadian Shock Troops, Death Korps Of Krieg, and Mordian Iron Guard use independent 4 / 6 / 8 Troop normal-copy allowances; Other preserves the existing 1 / 2 / 3 arithmetic exactly. Regiment configuration controls which Troop is normally available but does not merge their copy families. No generated, free, attached-zero-point, or otherwise exempt Troop unit exists in this catalogue. The parent retains automatic insertion, Required Additional Copy Costs Configuration, Uses Regiment Configuration, and duplicate-entry validation.

selectionEntries.name: Troops
selectionEntries.comment: TROOP COPY-COST LEDGER. Cadian Shock Troops, Death Korps Of Krieg, and Mordian Iron Guard are three independent Regiment Troop copy families using the GS17 4 / 6 / 8 normal-copy allowance. Regiment configuration already makes these mutually exclusive in ordinary use; the accounting remains per actual datasheet ID.

selectionEntries.name: Other
selectionEntries.comment: OTHER COPY-COST LEDGER. Contains all 108 pre-existing Other point modifiers unchanged, preserving the established 1 / 2 / 3 allowance across the same 18 copy families.

selectionEntries.comment:
CADIAN FINAL-STATE LOADOUT (REV6): compact model-accounting presentation. Loadout contains Sergeant, Cadian Shock Troopers 2-5 as fixed Lasguns, Cadian Shock Troopers 6-7 as the two paid special-weapon-capable models, and Weapon Specialist as the next model role with one free special-weapon choice. Special Weapons Team / Heavy Weapons Team is the final-state branch for the remaining two bodies: either Cadian Shock Troopers 9-10 as independently configured special-weapon-capable models, or one Heavy Weapons Team with a mandatory heavy weapon. The free specialist is labeled directly by role rather than as Cadian Shock Trooper 8.
REV8 WEAPON SPECIALIST DEFAULT: Player-facing Weapon Specialist slots no longer offer Lasgun. Grenade Launcher is the default free specialist weapon. Paid special-weapon-capable ordinary Guardsmen retain Lasgun because declining the paid upgrade remains a meaningful choice.
REV9 SPECIAL WEAPONS TEAM DEFAULT: Cadian Shock Troopers 9-10 under Special Weapons Team now omit Lasgun and default to Grenade Launcher, matching the dedicated Weapon Specialist treatment.

catalogue.comment:
PHASE 0.1 — REGIMENT + COMMAND SQUAD FOUNDATION
Focused assembly implementing the Astra Militarum Regiment selector, the three Regiment Troop anchors, the three Platoon Commanders, and the reusable Command Squad Officer pool. Regiments of Cadia is selected by default. The explicit Regiment selector is a listbuilder presentation abstraction over the PDF's indirect mutually exclusive Troop mechanic. Matching Platoon Commander Troop prerequisites remain enforced separately. Command Squad Officers are nested complete Leader units, reuse the Additional Leader architecture, and do not count toward Leader Capacity. Detailed Troop model/loadout trees and the remainder of the Astra Militarum catalogue are intentionally deferred to later assembly.

REV2 REGIMENT NAME CORRECTION
Corrected the player-facing Regiment option names to Cadia, Death Korps of Krieg, and Mordian Iron Guard. Updated Regiment-related constructive error text and condition labels accordingly. No unit names, IDs, costs, loadouts, visibility logic, Command Squad structure, or validation semantics were otherwise changed.

REV3 CADIAN REGIMENT LABEL
Changed the player-facing Regiment option from 'Cadia' to 'Regiments of Cadia' to better represent the broader Cadian military identity rather than a single regiment. Updated Regiment-related constructive error text and condition labels accordingly. Existing unit names, IDs, costs, loadouts, visibility logic, Command Squad structure, and validation semantics are unchanged.

REV4 CADIAN SHOCK TROOPS LOADOUT TEST
Implemented the complete player-facing Cadian Shock Troops loadout using a compressed final-state model: Cadian Sergeant; four fixed Lasguns; two paid special-weapon-capable Lasgun models; one independent free special-weapon-capable model; and a mandatory branch between two additional free special-weapon-capable models or one Heavy Weapons Team. This is a focused navigation test. Death Korps of Krieg and Mordian Iron Guard detailed Troop loadouts remain deferred.

REV5 CADIAN MILITARY-JARGON PRESENTATION
Baked the approved Cadian Shock Troops presentation labels. Loadout now contains Sergeant, Cadian Shock Troopers 2-5, 6, and 7. The independent free specialist is presented under Weapon Specialist as Cadian Shock Trooper 8. The remaining branch is presented as Special Weapons Team / Heavy Weapons Team, with Cadian Shock Troopers 9-10 under Special Weapons Team or the Heavy Weapons Team weapon choice. Existing selection IDs, costs, defaults, and legality logic are unchanged.

REV6 WEAPON SPECIALIST PRESENTATION
Collapsed the redundant Weapon Specialist wrapper. The free specialist now appears directly in Loadout after Cadian Shock Trooper 7, labeled Weapon Specialist. The obsolete presentation-wrapper object was removed; all actual choice/option IDs are preserved. Special Weapons Team / Heavy Weapons Team remains the next top-level section. Costs, defaults, and legality logic are unchanged.

REV7 DEATH KORPS AND MORDIAN TROOP LOADOUTS
Implemented the approved compact troop presentations for Death Korps of Krieg and Mordian Iron Guard. Death Korps uses Watchmaster, Death Korps Guardsman 2-8, and two Weapon Specialist slots. Mordian Iron Guard uses Mordian Sergeant, Mordian Guardsman 2-6, Mordian Guardsman 7, Mordian Guardsman 8, and two Weapon Specialist slots. Mordian Guardsmen 7-8 carry the two paid +10 special-weapon options; the two Weapon Specialist slots are free. All new IDs are deterministic; existing IDs are preserved.

REV8 WEAPON SPECIALIST DEFAULTS
For the three Regiment Troops, every player-facing Weapon Specialist slot now omits Lasgun and defaults to Grenade Launcher. This is an intentional listbuilder simplification: Grenade Launcher is a free specialist choice and the Lasgun fallback is not presented for these role-labeled specialists. Paid special-weapon-capable ordinary models retain Lasgun as their default because declining the +10 upgrade is still a meaningful decision. Cadian Special Weapons Team model slots are otherwise unchanged.

REV9 CADIAN SPECIAL WEAPONS TEAM DEFAULTS
Applied the same dedicated-specialist presentation to Cadian Shock Troopers 9-10 under Special Weapons Team: Lasgun removed, Grenade Launcher defaulted. No other loadout, points, Regiment, Commander, or Command Squad behavior changed.

REV10 TANK COMMANDER / ENGINSEER / COMMISSAR / TEMPESTUS SCIONS
Added the next three Leaders and the first Other unit. Tank Commander includes complete turret/hull choices, Vanquisher coaxial dependency, and Paid Wargear. Enginseer Envoy uses its fixed loadout. Commissar uses normal required Troops attachment semantics, does not consume Leader Capacity, and is Rare. Tempestus Scions use the approved compact five-model presentation with Tempestor, two fixed Scions, one paid-capable Scion, one Weapon Specialist, and Paid Wargear. Tempestus Scions also participate in generic Additional Copy Costs as a non-Rare Other unit.

REV11 TANK COMMANDER UI / COMMISSAR ATTACHMENT POINTS
Simplified Tank Commander Loadout presentation by suppressing redundant Turret/Hull/Sponson group labels. Moved the paid Sponson weapon choice into Loadout directly after the Hull weapon choice while preserving its points costs. Verified and retained Commissar attachment points on all three Regiment Troops; the Commissar remains a normal required-attached Leader.

REV12 KASRKINS
Added Kasrkins with Kill Team-inspired player-facing role names: Kasrkin Sergeant, Gunner, and Sharpshooter / Demo Trooper. The decisive source restriction is compiled as a dynamic roster max: one Kasrkin unit per two Cadian Shock Troops, rounded down. Kasrkins safely hide outside Regiments of Cadia and remain constructively invalid if already included when the Regiment changes. As a native non-Rare Other unit, Kasrkins also use Additional Copy Costs.

REV13 TRANSPORTS / VEHICLES / ARTILLERY
Added Chimera, Taurox, Leman Russ Battle Tank, Scout Sentinels, Armoured Sentinels, Hellhound, Basilisk, Wyvern, Manticore, Field Ordnance Battery, and Heavy Lascannon Battery. All are native non-Rare Other units and participate in Additional Copy Costs. Vehicle/Infantry semantic categories are applied from the UUS.
